conflicts: packages/daemon/src/daemon/index.ts: NONE. jj auto-merged: main (#967) inserted its `startWorkerStreamListener` try/catch immediately after `api = startLegionApi(...)`, the same anchor as the moved block; jj placed main's block first, then the moved block, then `enableWorkerPromotion()`.
